title: Search filters this deployment's catalog search applies
description: Example filter vocabulary for the elasticsearch provider. Each key is applied by the search template, which reads it as filters.<key>. A key not listed here is refused with UNIMPLEMENTED, and a value that breaks its key's rule with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

news.language.description: Only articles in this language: a two-letter lower-case ISO 639-1 code, for example "en".

news.date_published_after.description: Only articles published at or after this instant: a UTC date-time to the second, for example "2026-01-05T00:00:00Z".
